text:
Leipzig’s median asking rents sit at 10.0 €/m², up 1.5 % year‑on‑year and 30.7 % over the past five years, placing the city 23rd of the 37 most expensive markets. Listings clear in 31 days on average, with 26 % let within a week, reflecting a tight market and a vacancy rate of 2.2 %.

Affordability remains moderate: a 60 m² unit costs about 600 € per month and the rent‑burden for two residents is 15.2 %. The asking premium over existing rents is 55 % (existing rent 6.44 €/m²), underscoring strong demand amid limited supply.

The model estimate forecasts median asking rents of 10.67 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 10.33 €/m² and 10.99 €/m², implying a 6.7 % increase.
